preservers.evidence: Arena allocation writes only EAX/ECX/EDX and its two global cursor/count words. Its optional diagnostic callee BA870 is a single RET. EBX/EBP/ESI/EDI are unchanged on every returning path. Preserving a record pointer across this call does not give arbitrary arena allocations a callback type.

The complete seven-instruction identity-matrix writer uses XMM0..2 and ECX, writes 48 bytes at ECX, and returns without changing EBX/EBP/ESI/EDI. Queued draw producers pass their matrix field at record +14.
The complete seven-instruction matrix-copy helper uses XMM0..2 to copy 48 bytes from ECX to EDX. It has no calls and leaves EBX/EBP/ESI/EDI unchanged.
The complete routine loads global 73FE90 into EAX and returns. It neither changes EBX/EBP/ESI/EDI nor writes memory.

Preserves EBX/EBP/ESI/EDI (register bits 3/5/6/7). Its only callees are 15D10 and 73620. All returning paths through pool allocator 15D10 restore its saved EBX/ESI/EDI and do not write EBP. Initializer 73620 leaves EBX/EBP/ESI untouched and restores EDI after REP STOSD. The factory also saves/restores its own EBX at 736D6/736DE. This retains code-pointer values across allocation without assuming a convention for other internal routines.

Preserves EBX/EBP/ESI/EDI through the same verified 15D10/73620 helpers as 736C0. Its own EBX save/restore is at 73836/73840. The additional parent-linking instructions write only EAX/ECX/EDX and object memory; EBP/ESI/EDI remain unchanged.

Original CRT random-number routine writes only EAX/ECX after calling 30F332. The returning paths through 30F332 save ESI/EDI at 30F346/30F347 and restore them at 30F3AF/30F3B2. Its exceptional branch before those saves is a nonreturning kernel bug check. UI producer 2B0EE0 keeps callback 2AAD30 in ESI across this random-choice path and allocation.

Object +0x30 is invoked during release at 0x0007389F and 0x000738E2. Object +0x38 is invoked during drawing at 0x000770DB; its callers iterate the same 0xD0-byte pool and parent links.
